rationale.overall: B better matches the reference because its curled band keeps translucent volume and an open-loop read while A flattens that same element into a more opaque paper cutout, with both takes otherwise sharing a similar dark bar and orange underglow.
rationale.material: B’s curl carries continuous cylindrical shading and a shaded interior that echoes the reference’s frosted translucent ribbon, whereas A’s curl reads as a harder two-tone opaque strip with pasted grain and weaker light falloff.
rationale.silhouette: B’s outline still reads as a looped band with a visible mouth meeting the block, matching the reference, while A’s curl collapses toward a solid comma-like blob.
rationale.smallsize: At 32px and 16px both takes are dominated by the same dark diagonal bar and orange glow, and the curl reduces to a low-contrast pale smudge in each.
